name: Straßberg Alm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Straßberg Alm in Tirol**

Discover the **Straßberg Alm**, a picturesque alpine meadow nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this idyllic retreat offers breathtaking views of the **Nordkette** mountain range and the sparkling waters of the **Inn River** below.

Enjoy traditional **Tiroler** hospitality in the cozy **Almhütte**, where hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsekrainer**, and fresh mountain cheese are served with a smile. The rustic charm of the wooden huts and the crisp mountain air make this the perfect spot for relaxation and outdoor adventures.

Hike along well-marked trails, explore the lush meadows, or simply unwind with a glass of **Tiroler** apple juice or a frothy **Schnaps** by the fire. Whether you're seeking tranquility or an adrenaline rush—paragliding, mountain biking, or horseback riding are all within reach—**Straßberg Alm** promises an unforgettable alpine escape.

Open from **Juni** to **Oktober**, this hidden gem is a must-visit for nature lovers and food enthusiasts alike. Come experience the magic of **Tirol** at its finest!
